blocks.text: Grade 11 高频词汇 401–500
incinerate /in'sinəreit/ v.i. 烧成灰, 灰化；v.t. 焚化
The remaining ten pounds of unfissioned plutonium was joined with the soil, the sand, and the animal and plant life in the area and incinerated.
中文语境：剩余的十磅未裂变钚与该地区的土壤、沙子以及动植物生命结合在一起并被焚烧
overexposure /.əuvərik'spəuʒə/ n. 曝光过度；[医] 感光过度, 露光过度
My father's overexposure to high levels of radiation from the Trinity test as a child damaged his cells, which led to cancer and altered his DNA.
中文语境：我父亲小时候过度暴露于三位一体测试的高水平辐射下，损害了他的细胞，导致癌症并改变了他的 DNA
detonation /.detə'neiʃən/ n. 爆炸, 爆裂, 爆炸声；[化] 爆轰(化学反应速度高于其声速); 爆震; 引爆
Part of the history of Trinity is that there was a time following the detonation when people were allowed to freely go in and out of the site without obstruction.
中文语境：圣三一历史的一部分是，爆炸后有一段时间，人们可以不受阻碍地自由进出该地点
recidivism /ri'sidivizm/ n. 累犯；[医] 复发趋向, 再发趋向, 再犯趋向
It is also worth noting that recidivism rates in Scandinavia are low.
中文语境：还值得注意的是，斯堪的纳维亚半岛的累犯率较低
imprecise /.impri'saiz/ adj. 不严密的, 不精确的, 不明确的

"Demographic data about the ethnicity of American servicemen and women has historically been imprecise, and the number of Native Americans who served in the military are, for the most part, estimates," according to Harris.
中文语境：哈里斯表示，"关于美国军人种族的人口统计数据历来并不精确，在军队服役的美洲原住民人数大部分都是估计值"
encroach /in'krəutʃ/ v.i. 侵犯, 侵蚀, 蚕食；[法] 侵犯, 侵入, 侵占
Native Americans were enlisted - and given military pay - as scouts to help find tribes that were doing their best to defend themselves against encroaching settlers.
中文语境：美洲原住民被征召入伍并获得军饷作为侦察兵，帮助寻找正在尽最大努力抵御定居者入侵的部落
deleterious /.deli'tiəriəs/ adj. 有害的, 造成伤害的；[医] 有害的
Another highly deleterious financial episode occurred about a decade ago, when the collapse of the poorly regulated U.S.
中文语境：另一场高度有害的金融事件发生在大约十年前，当时监管不力的美国崩溃了
bilateral /bai'lætərəl/ adj. 有两边的, 双边的, 双方的；[医] 两侧的

These government-to-government, institution-to-institution, and person-to-person interactions have been made possible by more than two dozen bilateral and multilateral treaties and agreements that, in a variety of ways, have forged links among the 193 member states of the United Nations.
中文语境：这些政府对政府、机构对机构以及个人对个人的互动是通过二十多个双边和多边条约和协议实现的，这些条约和协议以各种方式在联合国 193 个成员国之间建立了联系
coronation /.kɔːrə'neiʃən/ n. 加冕礼

What the last Romanov did not have was an understanding and respect for the dirt-poor and frequently hungry peasants who eked out a meager living, and it was part of Nicholas' misfortune that his abysmal insensitivity and weakness were revealed on the very day after his coronation.
中文语境：最后的罗曼诺夫所缺乏的是对赤贫且经常挨饿的农民的理解和尊重，他们的生活微薄，而尼古拉斯的不幸的一部分是，他极度的麻木不仁和软弱在他加冕后的第二天就暴露了出来
dishearten /dis'hɑːtn/ v.t. 使...气馁, 使...沮丧

The execution of the czar's family was needed not only in order to frighten, horrify and dishearten the enemy, but also in order to shake up our own ranks to show that there was no turning back, that ahead lay either complete victory or complete ruin...
中文语境：处决沙皇一家不仅是为了震慑、恐吓和挫败敌人，也是为了撼动我们自己的队伍，表明我们已经没有回头路了，前方要么是彻底的胜利，要么是彻底的毁灭......
instructive /in'strʌktiv/ adj. 有益的, 增进知识的
But more instructive about the monarch was his reaction to the news in November 1894 that his father, Alexander III, had died and that he, Nicholas, would be the new Emperor of All Russia.
中文语境：但对这位君主更具启发性的是他对 1894 年 11 月他的父亲亚历山大三世去世、他尼古拉斯将成为全俄罗斯新皇帝的消息的反应
platinum /'plætinəm/ n. 白金, 铂, 银灰色；[化] 铂Pt

And the Romanovs' personal wealth was almost unimaginable: for example, Alexandra's wedding wardrobe included a tiara with 475 big diamonds set in platinum and earrings that were so heavy they had to be held by wires wrapped around her ears.
中文语境：罗曼诺夫家族的个人财富几乎难以想象：例如，亚历山德拉的婚礼服装包括一顶镶有 475 颗大钻石的铂金王冠和耳环，这些耳环非常重，必须用绕在耳朵上的金属丝来固定
paratrooper /'pærətruːpə/ n. 伞兵
Coral reefs near the beach sank some of the exiles' ships; paratroopers landed in the wrong place, and the main invasion force ran out of ammunition.
中文语境：海滩附近的珊瑚礁使一些流亡者的船只沉没；伞兵降落在错误的地点，主力入侵部队弹药耗尽
vacillate /'væsileit/ v.i. 游移不定, 踌躇, 犹豫, 摇摆
"Kennedy vacillated," he said.
中文语境："肯尼迪犹豫不决，"他说
visceral /'visərəl/ adj. 内脏的；[医] 内脏的
He had no visceral hatred of the United States, and as described by Tad Szulc, a New York Times correspondent who followed Castro's career for almost 20 years, he greatly admired President John F.
中文语境：他对美国并没有发自内心的仇恨，正如跟踪卡斯特罗职业生涯近20年的《纽约时报》记者塔德·苏尔克(Tad Szulc)所描述的，他非常钦佩约翰·肯尼迪总统
rapacious /rə'peiʃəs/ adj. 强夺的, 贪欲的, 贪婪的
on January 1, 1959, Batista fled, with $300 million in cash, to the protection of an equally rapacious Rafael Trujillo, the despotic boss of the Dominican Republic.
中文语境：1959年1月1日，巴蒂斯塔带着3亿美元现金出逃，去保护同样贪婪的多米尼加共和国专制老板拉斐尔·特鲁希略
pugnacious /pʌg'neiʃəs/ adj. 好斗的

Two years after the pugnacious Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev publicly put the Western nations on notice that "we will bury you!", Castro invited droves of Soviet security and military advisers to Cuba.
中文语境：好斗的苏联总理尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫公开向西方国家发出"我们将埋葬你！"的两年后，卡斯特罗邀请了大批苏联安全和军事顾问前往古巴
subpoena /səb'piːnə/ n. 传票；v.t. 传审, 传唤
He recommended that staffers perjure themselves if subpoenaed in court.
中文语境：他建议工作人员在法庭传唤时作伪证
perjure /'pəːdʒə/ v.t. 使发伪誓, 使作伪证, 使破坏誓言；[法] 作伪证, 发假誓
He recommended that staffers perjure themselves if subpoenaed in court.
中文语境：他建议工作人员在法庭传唤时作伪证
occlude /ə'kluːd/ v.t. 使闭塞, 隔断, 挡住；v.i. 咬合

During his years in office, Nixon had brought a controversial end to the Vietnam War, opened communication with Red China, watched NASA put astronauts on the moon, and presided over a healing period in American history in the early 1970s. Despite these many accomplishments, Watergate's shadow occludes Nixon's legacy.
中文语境：尼克松在执政期间结束了有争议的越南战争，与红色中国建立了沟通，目睹了美国宇航局将宇航员送上月球，并在 20 世纪 70 年代初主持了美国历史上的治愈时期。尽管取得了如此多的成就，水门事件的阴影遮蔽了尼克松的遗产
arrest /ə'rest/ n. 逮捕, 监禁；v.t. 拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止
To arrest the gaze of the passers-by;
中文语境：吸引路人的目光；
rapport /ræ'pɒː/ n. 关系, 融洽, 一致；[医] 关系, 协调(病人与医师间), 感通(唯心的灵交术时)
I mean you don't brag on yourself in the book, I'll just say this, but you clearly were able to have a rapport.
中文语境：我的意思是你没有在书中吹嘘自己，我只是这么说，但你们显然能够建立融洽的关系
flippant /'flipənt/ adj. 轻率的, 没礼貌的, 嘴碎的
He has a good sense of humor so I thought, oh, he's just being silly, being flippant.
中文语境：他很有幽默感，所以我想，哦，他只是很傻，很轻率
warden /'wɒːdn/ n. 典狱官, 渔猎法监督官, 看守人；[法] 看守人, 监护人, 管理员
I asked for permission from the administration and the warden at the time knew me and knew me to be, you know, a good college professor for many years.
中文语境：我请求了行政部门的许可，当时的典狱长认识我，并且知道我多年来一直是一名优秀的大学教授
fraudulent /'frɒːdjulənt/ adj. 欺诈的, 不正的, 不诚实的；[法] 欺诈的, 欺骗的, 骗取的
Although their votes were later ruled fraudulent, their candidate was elected to Congress.
中文语境：尽管他们的选票后来被裁定为欺诈，但他们的候选人还是当选为国会议员
levy /'levi/ n. 税款, 所征的人数, 征收；v.i. 征税, 课税；v.t. 征收, 强求, 召集
Brooks was levied a $300 fine, resigned, and returned home to South Carolina where people held events in his honor and reelected him to his House seat.
中文语境：布鲁克斯被处以 300 美元罚款，辞职后返回南卡罗来纳州的家乡，那里的人们为他举行了纪念活动，并再次选举他担任众议院席位
inflamed adj. 红肿的, 发炎的
The attack inflamed almost everyone.
中文语境：这次袭击几乎激怒了所有人
devout /di'vaut/ adj. 虔诚的, 虔敬的, 诚恳的
The Sack of Lawrence called for retaliation in the eyes of John Brown, a devout white abolitionist.
中文语境：在虔诚的白人废奴主义者约翰·布朗看来，解雇劳伦斯事件需要报复
objectionable /əb'dʒekʃənəbl/ adj. 会引起反对的, 令人讨厌的
The mother's paid work is seen as morally objectionable and thus as endangering the child, whereas the father's paid work is not.
中文语境：母亲的有酬工作在道德上被认为是令人反感的，因此会危及孩子，而父亲的有酬工作则不然
disparage /dis'pæridʒ/ v.t. 蔑视, 贬损；[法] 轻视, 贬低, 诽谤
I'm sorry." Another video shows contemporary teenagers disparaging the cellphone technology that inaugurated the century (It's so big!
中文语境：对不起。"另一个视频显示当代青少年贬低开启本世纪的手机技术（它太大了！
rotary /'rəutəri/ adj. 旋转的, 轮流的；n. 旋转式机器
In a funny video of children responding to rotary phones, one child sympathizes with adults: "This [pointing to a rotary phone] was your only mode of talking to people...
中文语境：在一段孩子们对旋转电话作出反应的有趣视频中，一个孩子同情成年人："这（指着旋转电话）是你与人交谈的唯一方式......
diminution /.dimi'njuːʃən/ n. 减少, 缩小, 减低；[医] 减少, 减小
And the first flip-phones were admired for their slenderness, not rejected for the additional diminution they had failed to achieve.
中文语境：第一批翻盖手机因其纤薄而受到赞赏，并没有因为未能实现的进一步缩小而被拒绝
revolutionize /.revə'luːʃənaiz/ v.t. 向...鼓吹革命, 使发生革命性剧变
His ideas for transmitting and recording signals helped revolutionize long-distance communication.
中文语境：他关于传输和记录信号的想法彻底改变了长途通信
humility /hjuː'militi/ n. 谦逊, 谦虚, 谦卑
But recognizing our limitations in imagining the past brings an important lesson in humility and in humanity: "They were just as we are, with less technology."
中文语境：但认识到我们在想象过去方面的局限性，带来了关于谦逊和人性的重要教训："他们和我们一样，技术较少。"
visionary /'viʒənəri/ adj. 幻像的, 幻想的, 梦想的；n. 有眼力的人, 空想家, 梦想者
This isn't to deny the possibility of visionaries - people with the creativity and daring to imagine how things could be different.
中文语境：这并不是否认有远见的人的可能性--有创造力并敢于想象事情会如何不同的人
imperialism /im'piəriəlizm/ n. 帝国主义, 帝制；[法] 帝国主义
It failed to protect China from Japanese invasion and imperialism.
中文语境：它未能保护中国免受日本侵略和帝国主义的侵害
reparation /.repə'reiʃən/ n. 补偿, 赔偿, 弥补, 修复, 修理；[经] 赔偿, 补偿, 修理
Germany was to admit guilt for the war and pay unlimited reparations.
中文语境：德国承认对战争有罪并支付无限的赔款
exemption /ig'zempʃən/ n. 解除, 免除, 免税；[化] 免检
The last time a draft had been used resulted in great rioting because wealthy people could purchase exemptions.
中文语境：上次使用征兵制导致了巨大的骚乱，因为富人可以购买豁免权
imperil /im'peril/ v.t. 使处于危险, 危害
The bitterness that swept Europe and America would prevent the securing of a just peace, imperiling the next generation as well.
中文语境：席卷欧洲和美国的痛苦将阻碍公正和平的实现，并危及下一代
subsidize /'sʌbsidaiz/ v.t. 补助, 资助, 贿赂；[经] 资助, 津贴, 给...补助金
The government subsidizes public housing, meaning that the government pays for part of the housing in order to keep rent costs low.
中文语境：政府补贴公共住房，意味着政府支付部分住房费用，以保持较低的租金成本
vernacular /və'nækjulə/ n. 本地话, 方言；adj. 地方的, 用本地语写成的
I know its grammar, its parts of speech; I know the subtleties of 2 3 its idioms, its vernacular words and phrases to which the native speaker has never given a 1.
中文语境：我知道它的语法，它的词类；我知道 2 3 它的习语、白话单词和短语的微妙之处，而母语人士从未给过 1 分
idiom /'idiəm/ n. 习语, 成语, 惯用语法, 方言
Idiom (noun)a common expression in a language, often easily understood by native speakers but memorized and learned by outsiders.
中文语境：习语（名词）一种语言中的常见表达方式，通常很容易被母语者理解，但被外地人记住和学习
squabble /'skwɒbl/ v.i. 争吵, 口角；n. 争吵, 口角
She told this story each time my real sister, Alexandra, and I were standing, arms crossed, facing away from each other after some squabble or fistfight.
中文语境：每当我和我真正的妹妹亚历山德拉（Alexandra）在争吵或打架后站着，双臂交叉，背对着对方时，她都会讲这个故事
innate /i'neit/ adj. 先天的, 天生的；[医] 先天的, 生来的
I was fascinated that I could have been oblivious to something that years later feels so natural, so innate as race does.
中文语境：令我着迷的是，我本可以忽视一些多年后感觉如此自然、如此与生俱来的东西，就像种族一样
oblivious /ə'bliviəs/ adj. 遗忘的, 健忘的, 不知不觉的；[法] 忘却的, 健忘的, 不在意的
I was fascinated that I could have been oblivious to something that years later feels so natural, so innate as race does.
中文语境：令我着迷的是，我本可以忽视一些多年后感觉如此自然、如此与生俱来的东西，就像种族一样
navigator /'nævigeitə/ n. 航海家；[法] 领航员, 驾驶员, 航海者
of the finest navigators
中文语境：最优秀的航海家
majestic /mə'dʒestik/ adj. 宏伟的, 庄严的
majestic in their sweeping landscape
中文语境：壮丽的风景
politics /'pɒlitiks/ n. 政治, 政治学, 政见, 政治活动；[法] 政治, 政治学, 政纲
of the politics
中文语境：政治
extrovert /'ekstrəuvəːt/ n. 外向性格的人；[医] 外倾[性格]者
We even controlled for personality traits, such as being an extrovert and being open to new experiences.
中文语境：我们甚至控制了性格特征，例如外向和乐于接受新体验
innovative /'inəjveitiv/ adj. 革新的, 创新的, 富有革新精神的
New research we conducted recently shows that double majors fare better in another way as well: They are more innovative.
中文语境：我们最近进行的新研究表明，双专业在另一个方面也表现得更好：它们更具创新性
persuasive /pə'sweisiv/ adj. 有说服力的, 劝诱的, 劝导性的
These capacities include skills related to networking, persuasive communication, working on diverse teams, and risk taking.
中文语境：这些能力包括与网络、说服性沟通、在不同团队中工作以及承担风险相关的技能
faculty /'fækəlti/ n. 才能, 能力, 全体教员, (大学的)系；[医] 能力, [大学]院系
We also considered the institution students attended, the quality of teaching to which they were exposed and the nature of their interactions with faculty members.
中文语境：我们还考虑了学生就读的院校、他们所接受的教学质量以及他们与教职员工互动的性质
ambiguity /.æmbi'gjuːiti/ n. 不明确, 含糊；[计] 二义性; 多义性

We must do our best to educate students in a global environment, keeping pace with technological innovations, teaching critical thinking, fostering comfort with ambiguity, and graduating nimble leaders who will thrive in a rapidly changing era.
中文语境：我们必须尽最大努力在全球环境中教育学生，跟上技术创新的步伐，教授批判性思维，培养对模糊性的适应能力，并培养出在快速变化的时代蓬勃发展的灵活领导者
economically /iːkə'nɔmikəli/ adv. 节约地, 不浪费地, 节省地, 节俭地, 在经济上, 在经济学上
Private colleges and universities are also struggling to make ends meet, steering a record amount of tuition revenue toward grant aid for economically needy students.
中文语境：私立学院和大学也在努力维持收支平衡，将创纪录的学费收入用于为经济困难的学生提供资助
untenable /.ʌn'tenəbl/ adj. 不能防守的, 不能维持的, 支持不住的, (主张等)站不住脚的
"The magnitude of the situation is untenable," said Gov.
中文语境：州长说："情况的严重程度是站不住脚的。"
abound /ə'baund/ v.i. 大量存在, 富于, 充满
Editor's note: When it comes to the cost of higher education in the U.S., signs of trouble abound.
中文语境：编者注：当谈到美国的高等教育成本时，麻烦的迹象比比皆是
infrastructure /'infrəstrʌktʃə/ n. 基础结构, 基础设施；[经] 基础设施

On top of shrinking state appropriations there are more technology-intensive degrees in every field; an aging campus infrastructure; a sharp increase in compliance and regulations reporting; and soaring health care costs.
中文语境：除了国家拨款缩减之外，各个领域的技术密集型学位也有所增加；校园基础设施老化；合规和法规报告急剧增加；以及不断飙升的医疗费用
critical /'kritikəl/ adj. 批评的, 决定性的, 危险的, 临界的；[医] 危象的; 临界的, 极期的
The simple fact is that timely completion of a degree is a critical mechanism to control total cost.
中文语境：一个简单的事实是，及时完成学位是控制总成本的关键机制
credential /kri'denʃəl/ n. 国书, 凭据, 证明书；[经] 凭证, 证书
For many students, failing to complete college in six years means not only carrying debt but carrying debt without receiving a degree or credential, which means decreased job prospects.
中文语境：对于许多学生来说，六年内未能完成大学学业不仅意味着背负债务，而且还意味着在没有获得学位或证书的情况下背负债务，这意味着就业前景下降
